target.statement: CER of the proposed MNAR-k-means method on synthetic 2D Gaussian data (k=2, a=2, lambda*=0.1) is lower than k-POD and close to fully-observed k-means (Figure 2, one panel/cell).
target.dataset: Synthetic 2D Gaussian mixture (n=100k, k=2, a=2), MNAR0 missingness with lambda*=0.1

compute.basis: Synthetic data generation plus a few hundred k-means iterations on n=200-400 points in 2D; 30 repetitions and lambda tuning are cheap on CPU.

blockers: Code repo may be incomplete or not match paper (R/MATLAB mix for baselines)
Exact figure values not tabulated; only qualitative reproduction of the trend is feasible
Instability-based lambda selection and 100 initializations add implementation effort
title: MNAR-$k$-means: A $k$-means Clustering for Data Missing Not at Random with Magnitude-Decaying Probability
